name: fx_studio_open
title: Open FX Studio
description: Opens the live FX Studio creative workbench, optionally on a saved scene. The same view updates as its actual HTML/CSS/JavaScript source changes through scene_read, scene_write or scene_edit and as scene_preview renders images. Supports DOM, SVG, Canvas and WebGL through one programmable scene contract. Opening is read-only and does not create an effect or change production defaults. Returns a first-party studio link for hosts without app rendering. The view stays current through successive edits; only this tool opens the app.

scene_id.description: Optional account-owned scene identifier; without it the effect library opens.

has_more.description: True when the account has more scenes than the listed ones.

blockers.description: Typed blockers; empty when the call succeeded.
